references.text: The priest shall examine and assess whether the plague has faded, a recurring theme in the evaluation of leprosy in garments and skin.
Also describes a faded plague (כֵּהָה) that the priest must evaluate after washing; the same terminology is used.
Part of the same section on leprosy in garments, describing the assessment and burning of the garment with the plague.
The continuation of instructions regarding leprosy in garments, describing what should be done if the plague reappears.
Parallel to tearing out the affected part, here it concerns a house with leprosy where infected stones must be removed.
